papers.title_en: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
papers.authors: Guy Dar
papers.evidence: 面向百万级步骤的智能体调试、聚类与监控系统
papers.tldr: 真实规模下，智能体运行会持续产生海量步骤，调试、聚类与监控难以高效开展。Taxi 以聚类构建步骤分类体系，提供全量 SQL 查询，并由编码智能体引导聚类与查询组成混合流水线。系统可高效扩展到百万级步骤，还实验性集成 Jev 式决策模型，用类型化概率决策补充嵌入和字面查询。其内置评估器、日报与模块化可插拔生态，使个人和团队能即插即用地分析智能体。
papers.abstract_en: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

papers.title_en: SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents
papers.authors: Atahan Dokme, Adar Avsian, Larry Heck
papers.evidence: 提出面向AI智能体错误恢复的基准数据集与评测框架
papers.tldr: AI agent执行任务时会犯错，现有恢复基准多注入故障、缺少用户交互且只看最终成功。SecondChance利用τ²-bench、BFCL和AppWorld中的自然错误构建检查点，在四种辅助条件下评估12个模型的5760次续作。最佳模型无辅助仅16%恢复、有修复指导27%，纠正错误不等于完成任务。该基准揭示任务成功率无法捕捉的恢复行为差异。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $τ^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of $τ^2$ errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

papers.title_en: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
papers.authors: Qingle Liu, Jieming Li, Pei-lin Li, Shenghan Zheng, Ruize Yang, Sunqi Fan, Deyao Hong, Huan-ang Gao, Meng-Hao Guo, Shuojin Yang
papers.evidence: 面向计算机与机器人环境的智能体上下文学习在线基准
papers.tldr: 现有智能体ICL评测多为离线文本或静态图像，存在数据污染风险，机器人评测也局限于方法消融。作者提出在线基准ICLWorld与统一接口UIverse，覆盖电脑和机器人使用，构建30个环境、630段演示视频及160个含反直觉规则的任务，并用文本/视频三种规则版本测试三级泛化。六款前沿模型中，最强智能体电脑任务成功率达82%/76%，机器人仅27%/26%，无规则对照至多8%，揭示数字与物理世界以及“识别规则”与“执行规则”间的显著差距。
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

papers.title_en: KuroANN: Avoiding Unnecessary SSD Reads in High-Recall Filtered Vector Search
papers.authors: Soobin Cho, Nakyung Lee, Jiwoong Park, Gyuyeong Kim
papers.evidence: 面向分区索引的SSD过滤向量检索系统
papers.tldr: 在分区索引的SSD过滤向量搜索中，现有方法按选择率区间给查询分配相同SSD读取量，导致大量冗余I/O。KuroANN利用查询前已知的过滤匹配数，为每个查询定制探测分区数与候选读取量，并在继续读取收益低时提前停止。实验显示其在高召回下相较PipeANN-Filter和Faiss最高提升34.5倍和9.10倍。该工作显著减少无效SSD读取与过滤开销，提升吞吐和延迟表现。
papers.abstract_en: We present KuroANN, a new on-SSD filtered vector search system for partition indexes. Existing solutions assign the same number of SSD reads to all queries within a given selectivity range, wasting I/O for many queries. KuroANN instead assigns each query's SSD reads based on the number of vectors that pass its filter, called its match count. This is based on our observation that the match count is known before the search and that the number of SSD reads a query requires depends on this match count. KuroANN measures offline how many partitions to probe and candidates to read for the target recall at each count. At runtime, a query looks up these numbers, filters only the probed partitions, and stops reading from the SSD when further reads are unlikely to help. This significantly avoids unnecessary SSD reads and filtering work, improving throughput and latency at high recall. Experimental results show that KuroANN outperforms PipeANN-Filter and Faiss by up to 34.5x and 9.10x, respectively.

papers.title_en: SpecEngineeringBench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Autonomous Specification Engineers
papers.authors: Xingjian Wang, Shijian Wang, Minghao Liu, Ji Zou, Zetao Yang, Xinping Lei, Yiming Liang, Shen Yan, Enduo Zhao, Xiaoyang Shen, Weihao Xuan, Jiaheng Liu, Ge Zhang
papers.evidence: 提出评测编码智能体自主规格工程能力的基准
papers.tldr: 现有基准常直接提供问题描述、测试入口或待查文件，难以评估智能体自主决定“测什么、查哪里”的能力。作者提出 SpecEngineeringBench，覆盖 78 个 Python 仓库的 100 个实例，设置测试生成与缺陷发现两项任务，并联合评估测试有效性、缺陷检测、覆盖率及定位精度。七个前沿编码智能体测试有效性与覆盖率较高，但缺陷暴露和函数级定位明显不足。该基准揭示自主规格工程的关键短板，并显示自主测试生成可提升缺陷定位召回。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous specification engineering requires coding agents to translate functional requirements into executable tests and use the results to discover and validate defects. However, existing benchmarks evaluate coding agents on explicitly specified test generation tasks, commonly providing an issue description, a designated test entry point, or files to inspect, leaving the ability to determine what to test and where to investigate insufficiently evaluated. Relying on such clues bypasses the challenge of mapping requirements to implementations and proactively uncovering unknown defects. We propose SpecEngineeringBench, comprising 100 instances from 78 open-source Python repositories across 16 application categories, with multiple recorded defects in each instance. Two independent tasks evaluate complementary capabilities: generating test suites and discovering defects through execution analysis. The evaluation combines test validity, defect detection, and coverage with localization precision and recall. Across seven frontier coding agents, results reveal that test validity and coverage decouple from defect exposure: agents achieve a 91.47% Head Pass Rate and 80.48% Change-focused Coverage alongside a 26.36% Fail-to-Pass Rate, while localization recall drops from 78.11% at the file level to 51.29% at the function level. Autonomous test generation improves file, function, and hunk localization recall by 4.99, 2.77, and 2.69 percentage points over relying solely on existing repository test suites.

papers.title_en: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
papers.authors: Shuguang Chen, Salman Paracha
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的效用导向外部记忆系统
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体记忆多把记忆视为对过去的忠实记录，并用对话保真度评估，却忽略记忆是否真正改善后续回答。Leto将记忆视为面向未来的预测问题：通过记忆索引保留对话细节的可访问来源，在请求到来时用记忆重放补足隐含上下文，并利用回答结果形成效用闭环以优化未来记忆选择。实验覆盖个性化、长程任务和长上下文理解，在PrefEval准确率上领先最强基线16.3个百分点，长程任务随链深增益扩大，长上下文场景以更少token达到相当效果。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

papers.title_en: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
papers.authors: Xingjian Ran, Xiaoye Mo, Sihao Liu, Li Luo, Taiqiang Wu, Ji Zhao, Wenqi Shao, Hongyang Li, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Dai
papers.evidence: 提出ROAM-Bench基准以评测具身自主智能体
papers.tldr: 现有具身空间智能基准难以区分结果正确与任务要求是否真正完成。ROAM-Bench在机器人运动与碰撞约束下，用仿真状态和回合记录独立核查结果及几何、覆盖、放置等要求。它含5组11类250个经人工验证任务，覆盖27个室内环境；7个前沿视觉语言模型暴露出两类互补失败模式，人类严格成功率达84%。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

papers.title_en: Structure-Exploiting Hierarchical Retrieval for Long Narrative Documents: A Precision-Oriented Alternative to Learned Abstraction Trees
papers.authors: Rohit Singh, Nathaniel Weems
papers.evidence: 面向长文档的检索增强生成与稠密检索
papers.tldr: 面向书长叙事文档的检索增强生成，平坦稠密检索忽略结构，RAPTOR则依赖聚类摘要构建层级。本文利用原生章节结构：先以章节回顾的BM25+稠密混合匹配选章，再做章内稠密检索，并在令牌预算下扩展为连续、段落感知的文本块，辅以内容哈希门控的增量索引。在五本书、QuALITY与NovelQA上，方法在QuALITY显著优于平坦top-k（81.0%对70.4%），NovelQA与平坦检索持平；相对RAPTOR呈现互补权衡而非全面超越，增量更新可复用94%–99.7%嵌入。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over book-length documents must locate a small, coherent set of passages inside tens of thousands of tokens. Flat dense retrieval ignores document structure; RAPTOR instead builds a hierarchy by recursively clustering and summarizing with a language model. We study a complementary design that exploits the native structure of a document: a two-level retriever that (i) selects chapters with a hybrid BM25+dense match over chapter recaps, (ii) runs a chapter-filtered dense search, and (iii) expands top passages into contiguous, section-aware spans under a token budget, plus content-hash-gated delta ingestion to keep the index cheap to update. We evaluate on five public-domain books (113 chapter-localization queries) and on QuALITY and NovelQA (200K+ token novels). In-house, we find a seed-stable precision/ranking tradeoff: with section expansion off, hierarchical retrieval returns a higher fraction of chunks from the correct chapter (+3.3pp, Wilcoxon p=0.014); with expansion on, ranking improves (MRR, p=0.040). Accuracy differences are not significant. On QuALITY, hierarchical retrieval beats flat top-k (81.0% vs 70.4%, p=0.0019) and matches the full article (p=0.74). On NovelQA, hierarchical and flat retrieval are statistically tied (55.7% vs 56.8%, p=0.24); hierarchy helps aggregation questions while flat wins on localized facts. Against a faithful RAPTOR baseline we find a complementary tradeoff, not superiority. Delta ingestion reuses 94 to 99.7% of embeddings on incremental edits. We make no claim of semantic chapter-boundary inference and scope claims to English narrative prose.

papers.title_en: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
papers.authors: Zelong Wang, Weiyue Li, Fei Xue, Junru Zhu
papers.evidence: 用于评估与比较网页智能体表现的判定规则
papers.tldr: 网页智能体评测常以成功率提升判断优劣，但比较本身依赖成功定义、证据支持与差异估计。本文在固定执行上改变裁判规则，区分支持完成与未解决完成，并用受控来源增补分析缺失关系的影响。结果显示严格证据可消除大部分领先却不改排名，且双方估计更准未必使差异更准。作者提出用配对标签直接估计差异，为评估声明改进提供可核查依据。
papers.abstract_en: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

papers.title_en: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Changwei Lv, Yunfei Li, Zhongjing Du, Kehui Tan, Zijun Liao, Ruochong Zheng, Hao Chen, Can Deng, Zheni Zeng, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.evidence: 面向智能体长期记忆的任务感知多模态记忆框架
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体长期积累对话、图像和文档，但跨记录证据难以保留，相关问题容易重复出错。MMMem是任务感知的多模态记忆框架，通过源关联多视图记忆、源生成任务对齐、经验蒸馏和任务感知检索复用，巩固已完成任务的经验。在三个记忆基准和两个视觉语言阅读器上，它优于八个基线；Qwen3.5-9B在LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery、LooGLE v2上相对最佳基线分别提升36.9%、17.6%、15.2%。该工作使智能体能够持续从任务中学习并保留多模态经验。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

papers.title_en: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Wenhao Wang, Panrong Tong, Quyu Kong, Pengxiang Li, Haowen Yang, chenglin Cai, Siheng Chen, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 面向计算机使用智能体的闭环评测环境
papers.tldr: 计算机使用智能体能力快速提升，但评测基准多为静态，存在难度上限固定、覆盖有限和总分粗糙等问题。CUA-SEE构建闭环评测环境，从rollout证据中共同演化任务与可执行验证器，并分别推进基准、诊断与验证器演化。它能在多智能体、多应用和多轮评测中生成有挑战且可度量、保留过程证据的任务。该工作将自适应评测作为自演化智能体的可扩展配套，持续追踪能力、边界与度量可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

papers.title_en: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Xiaokang Liu, Ke Sun, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 评估机器人使用接口如何影响智能体成功率的基准
papers.tldr: 基础模型具备物理任务推理能力，但从智能到可靠机器人执行仍受接口制约。作者提出RUIBench，覆盖五类30个操作任务，并用RUIKit统一组合六种动作抽象与两种交互形式，形成13种接口。仿真中仅改变接口即可让前沿智能体成功率从45%升至81%，微调4B模型从13%升至47%，并揭示智能体常误报成功的验证缺口。该工作将机器人使用接口确立为具身智能可靠性的关键设计因素。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

papers.title_en: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
papers.authors: Ramraj Chandradevan, Sayontan Ghosh, Vinoth Selvendran
papers.evidence: 基于智能体轨迹的干预式归因，分析各行为角色的贡献
papers.tldr: 强化学习（RL）可将大模型搜索智能体的精确匹配提升至多32点，但总增益无法揭示哪些能力在起作用。作者提出CO-GRAFT，让RL训练后的策略与训练前初始化在实时检索闭环中共同生成一条轨迹，各自只控制推理、搜索或作答决策、查询生成、答案抽取这四个角色中互斥的一部分。穷举16种角色分配构成合作博弈，用Shapley值分解增益、用Möbius交互项区分独立改进与耦合。在Qwen2.5与Llama-3.2等多种设置上，查询生成的贡献不足15%，增益主要取决于答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模与固定搜索预算。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.

papers.title_en: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
papers.authors: Brian M. Cho, Michael Lindon, Nathan Kallus
papers.evidence: 基于轨迹上决策质量评估自主智能体
papers.tldr: 编码与科学智能体日益端到端自主，但实验噪声大且常无外部真值，传统评估受限。论文把智能体质量定义为轨迹上正确决策的加权和，以e-value序列替代真值标签，并兼容任意依赖、数据依赖终止、动态假设和事后质量定义。作者构造质量的上、下界估计与置信集，给出对轨迹分布一致成立的统计保证，并证明估计器类实例级锐性。案例比较Claude Opus与Haiku改进开源Python包运行时的效果。
papers.abstract_en: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator class. We demonstrate our methods with a case study comparing the success of Claude Opus and Claude Haiku in improving the runtime of an open-source Python package.

papers.title_en: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
papers.authors: Meilu Zhu, Xiaohan Li, Axiu Mao
papers.evidence: 审计大模型诊断智能体基准构建与事后信息泄漏
papers.tldr: 临床诊断智能体基准常由回顾性病历构建，模拟器可能看到最终诊断，导致后见之明泄漏。HindAudit 将泄漏拆为模拟器诊断输入、回顾性上下文和智能体可见病例文本三条通道，并用仅真实数据训练的判别器逐项审计。在 MIMIC-IV 的 27,489 例急诊入院中，模拟检验结果未见泄漏，最大偏差来自病例文本：基准式摘要使四个 LLM 零样本准确率从 25.4% 升至 39.7%。研究给出构建建议，并指出因缺乏同期床旁病史，该差距只是后见之明上界。
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7% and discharge histories to 45.3%, and raised six interactive agents' scores while barely changing their ranking. The exploratory gap was reproduced in a registered replication on held-out patients. Masking diagnosis names left it unchanged. Because MIMIC lacks a contemporaneous bedside history, the gap is an upper bound on hindsight. We report all registered outcomes and recommend construction practices.

papers.title_en: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
papers.authors: Zibin Lin, Taotao Wang, Shengli Zhang
papers.evidence: 自主个人智能体的持久记忆生命周期
papers.tldr: 个人智能体依靠持久记忆把私密经验带入后续决策，跨载体迁移使隐私保护与删除更复杂。本文以主题综述比较记忆准入、维护、释放和撤回，并按受保护变更、观察者与验证设置组织证据。三个工作场景追踪同一私密事实，揭示提示修订与记忆读取的组合、技能对私有边界的继承，以及读者未使用不等于学习状态清除。诊断实验进一步量化扩大标签保护和广泛删除的效用成本，并说明谱系缺失会掩盖后代，为自演化智能体隐私保护提供分析框架与证据。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents carry private experience into later decisions through persistent memory. This thematic survey compares memory admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal by protected change, observer, and validation setting. Direct evidence in the screened corpus comes from controlled memory workflows. Three worked scenarios follow one private fact through booking, feedback-driven learning, and withdrawal. We show when prompt revision and memory reads compose, when skills inherit a private head's bound, and why reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state. Diagnostic experiments measure the utility costs of wider label protection and broad memory deletion, and test how missing lineage obscures descendants.

papers.title_en: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
papers.authors: Pinaki Prasad Guha Neogi, Spyros Mastorakis, Ankur Mallick, Saravan Rajmohan, Victor Rühle
papers.evidence: 面向LLM研究的持久知识库，含智能体记忆与决策感知检索
papers.tldr: 针对LLM服务配置优化中“该研究什么”比预测性能更难的问题，NoeVera构建可追溯的智能体第二大脑，整合论文、代码、基准与实验结果。它通过决策感知检索生成证据包，角色化智能体按需调用Vidur或GAUSS仿真器，并将发现写回有范围限定的证据记录。四类服务场景中，中位6-7次仿真调用即达最优5%以内，优于贝叶斯优化和同等工具的无知识智能体。A100上代表配置约达vLLM默认1.30倍吞吐并满足时延目标，且证据复用显著降低过泛化。
papers.abstract_en: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

papers.title_en: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.authors: Wenlong Yu, Bingxu Lu, Qilong Wang, Qinghua Hu, Qianru Sun
papers.evidence: 提出多智能体大模型系统的错误传播基准ErrPropBench-10
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM系统中错误会沿中间消息传播并影响最终答案，但结果导向评估难以刻画各智能体如何放大、衰减或纠正错误。为此提出REPA结构化模型，将局部响应与系统级错误传播相连，分别估计输入组装与智能体处理的多误差通道。基于3个Qwen基座、6种工作流和10类任务的ErrPropBench-10上，REPA条件级平均Spearman相关达0.84，显著高于直接回归的0.47。该框架还支持定向恢复，指导RAG平均提升19个百分点且仅增16% token。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs), errors can propagate through intermediate messages and compromise final answers. However, outcome-based evaluation obscures how agents amplify, attenuate, or correct these errors. We propose Response-Aware Error Propagation among Agents (REPA), a structural model that connects measured local responses to system-level error propagation. REPA separately estimates input assembly and agent processing across multiple error channels, while theoretical analysis relates local modeling errors to endpoint prediction error. Experiments span three Qwen base models, six MAS workflows, and ten knowledge and reasoning settings in ErrPropBench-10. REPA achieves a mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 across base models, compared with 0.47 for direct regression. Controlled experiments also demonstrate its utility for targeted recovery. REPA-guided retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves accuracy over no retrieval by an average of 19 percentage points with 16% additional tokens. By linking local agent behavior to system susceptibility, REPA provides an interpretable foundation for studying error propagation and developing targeted optimization in MAS.

papers.title_en: Query Obfuscation with Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON): A Representational Blindspot in Agentic Retrieval
papers.authors: Ankit Gupta, Christoph Adami, Emily Dolson
papers.evidence: 智能体语义检索中稠密嵌入的表示性失效模式
papers.tldr: 在智能体与语义检索中，稠密嵌入模型决定意图、工具、文档与记忆召回，却存在表示层盲点：语义明确的查询可被看似无语义的内容替换，仍保留大量检索结果。作者提出嵌入优化噪声 EON，仅利用自然查询表示构造，不访问候选库、相关性标签、排序或检索反馈。实验显示 EON 在工具路由、基准文档搜索、情节记忆检索和跨模态搜索中常保持意图，并可绕过输入护栏执行恶意查询。该研究揭示双编码器系统的 BLINDSPOT 风险：系统对非语义伪影视而不见，却仍能可靠召回真实内容。
papers.abstract_en: In modern agentic and semantic retrieval systems, dense embedding models increasingly determine which intent, tool, document, memory, or image to retrieve for a query. We identify a representational failure mode in this pipeline: a meaningful query can be replaced by visibly nonsemantic content while preserving much of its retrieval outcome, even when the candidate bank is hidden from the optimizer. We introduce Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), constructed using only the natural query representation, without access to candidate embeddings, relevance labels, rankings, retrieval feedback, or guardrail decisions. Despite this corpus-blind objective, EONs frequently preserve intent and tool routing, benchmark document search, episodic agent-memory retrieval, and cross-modal search across multiple dense embedding families. Crucially, this disconnect carries serious security implications: for malicious queries, an EON can reliably evade input guardrails that block the natural query, executing the intended safety-sensitive retrieval undetected. Through the geometry of the embedding space, we then characterize how query-level representation matching can reliably maintain subsequent retrieval outcomes over candidates unseen during optimization. Together, these findings expose a fundamental phenomenon across dual encoders that we call BLINDSPOT, where systems remain operationally blind to nonsemantic artifacts while reliably retrieving real, consequential content.

papers.title_en: Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study
papers.authors: Sayed Amir Karim
papers.evidence: 面向语义检索的稠密嵌入与学习投影方法
papers.tldr: 稠密检索在近重复陷阱文档上易被误导，原始余弦可将反转文档排进前10达82–100%。作者训练小型线性投影W，将1024维嵌入压到11或32维以抑制语义反转陷阱，并用边界值求解加速谱图检索。四个领域、十万规模下HN@10均为0，正确复述保留93–99%，约300查询检索耗时0.6–1.1秒。该方案使按领域或租户构建小索引成为大向量库的实用替代。
papers.abstract_en: Dense-embedding retrievers can fail adversarially: when a query is answered by a document A and reversed by a near-copy B that differs from A by a small meaning-changing edit (a "trap"), raw cosine over E5-Large-v2 places B in the top-10 for 82-100% of queries at a pool of 5,000. We study two things. First, a small learned projection W: R^1024 -> R^d (d in {11, 32}), trained by a deterministic recipe on a declared set of cases, that suppresses the trap: for the declared cases, HN@10 = 0.0000 (no trap in the top-10) in all twelve (domain, pool-size) settings across four independent domains (legal, medical, patent, financial) and pools up to 100,000, while the correct paraphrase is retained for 93-99% of cases, under exact nearest-neighbour search. Second, a boundary-conditioned accelerator that serves the projection at that scale: an acceleration of spectral graph retrieval (SpectRAG) that replaces a dense eigendecomposition with a boundary-value solve, holding HN@10 = 0.0000 at n = 100,000 in every domain and retrieving the ~300-query suite in 0.6-1.1 s (~2-4 ms per query on average). Because the lens's output is the stored representation (a few floats per document), a hardened, specialised index per domain or tenant is ~90x smaller and dimension-proportionally faster than the full embedding, making many small declared indexes a practical alternative to one large vector store. The claim is scoped to the declared cases on the measured pools, with no probabilistic bound; the correct-answer rate drops for a reworded query against an unchanged corpus (about 0.79, trap suppression still holding). A projection transfers only partly to other domains, which we report in full. The recipe, lenses, trap sets and evaluation harness are released under AGPL-3.0; the accelerator's implementation is a reserved commercial component, and every HN number is reproducible under exact search.

papers.title_en: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.authors: Priyesh Vakharia, Masud Moshtaghi, Pratyay Banerjee, Nicholas Jedema, Amita Misra, Ankit Chadha
papers.evidence: 将稠密检索与 SPARQL 规划的图谱遍历交错用于多跳知识密集问答
papers.tldr: 多跳问答中，语义检索常因干扰段落而召回与精度难兼顾，GraphRAG多跳扩展又昂贵且引入噪声。本文交错稠密检索与Wikidata图谱遍历，让LLM生成SPARQL遍历计划但仅解析不执行，以推理路径校验检索段落。统一配置下，HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue分别达62.5/75.1、73.5/81.0、37.1/50.0 EM/F1，均超HippoRAG2、T²RAG和IRCoT。结果表明，解析式SPARQL规划能低成本提升多跳检索的精度与召回。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emph{parse rather than execute} the query. On full 1{,}000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf{62.5 / 75.1} EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf{73.5 / 81.0} on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf{37.1 / 50.0} on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript{2}RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript{2}RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.
